paite: Aw Le Lebanon, mei in na sidar singte akattum theihna ding in na kongkhakte hong in.
heading: Lebanon Khopi Pukna
english: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.

paite: Aw meilah sing, mau vongvong in, Sidar sing apukta ngal a, ahoih tatate hihsiat a a-om ziak un; Aw nou Bashan tosaw singte chiau vongvong un, gammangpi vatpaih ahita hi.
english: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.

paite: Ngai un belamching mite amau vongvong ding ua, na thupina uh loh a a-om ziak in, ngai un humpinelkai ahumham a, Jordan gammang athengta hi!
english: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed—a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.

paite: Hichibang in TOUPA ka Pathian in achi hi, "Goh ding belamhon chingpa hong hi in.
heading: Belampu Chi Nihte
english: Yahweh my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.

paite: Amau leite'n athat ua, gawt in a-om kei ua; amau zuakte'n TOUPA phat in om hen! Ka hauta uh! Amau chingte'n alainat kei uhi,” achi uhi.
english: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.

paite: "Gam a tengte ka hehpih nawn kei ding, TOUPA'N achi. Himahleh ngai in mite michih a-invengte khut ah leh akumpipa khut ah ka pe ding; amau gam agawt ding ua, akhut ua kipan amaute ka hunkhe kei ding," chi in.
english: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says Yahweh; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”

paite: "Huchi in belamte a sumdawngte a dia thah ding a om belamte chingpa ka hong hita hi. Huchi in chiang nih ka kilak a; khat pen 'Deihsakna' ka chi a, adang pen 'Kizopna' ka chi; huchi in belamte ka vak hi.
english: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.

paite: Huan kha khat in belamchingmi thum ka satkhia hi. Himahleh ka kha in amau achimtak a, amau kha in leng kei ahon chimtak uhi.
english: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.

paite: Huaitak in ke'n, 'K'on vak kei ding, asi dingte, si henla, satkhiak a om dingte, satkhiak in om heh; nutsiatte khat-le-khat sa kinetuah uhen,' ka chita hi.
english: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”

paite: Huan 'Deihsakna' kichi ka chiangkhun ka la a, ka sattan a, mite tengteng toh ka thukhun ka bawl ka suksiat theihna ding in.
english: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

paite: Huchi in huai ni in akitanta, huchi in pawlte lak ah agenthei kei hon limsakte'n TOUPA thu ahi chih athei uhi.
english: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was Yahweh’s word.

paite: Ke'n akiang uah, 'Hoih a na ngaihtuah ualeh ka loh tak hon pia, un ahihkeileh, tang un,' ka chi hi. Huchi in ka loh tak ding in 'dangka shekel sawmthum' abuk uhi.
english: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.

paite: "Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, 'Ka man ding a aseh uh, man hoih belvelmi kiang ah khia in,' achi hi. Dangka shekel sawmthum ka la a TOUPA' inn a, belvelmi kiang ah ka khia hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in Judah leh Israel kikal a ki-unauna ka suksiat theihna ding in, ka chiangkhun dang 'Kizopna' kichi pen ka tumtan hi.
english: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

paite: "Huan TOUPA'n ka kiang ah, 'Belamching mihai vanzatte kilak nawn in,' achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

paite: Ngai in, gamsung ah belamchingmi ka bawlkhe ding hi. Ama'n satkhiak a om dingte aveh kei dia, delhzak a om dingte leng azong sam kei dia, satkeh a omte leng ahihdam sam kei ding, ahoih leng avak sam kei dia, himahleh athaute sa ane ding a, achinte nangawn uh atolsak ding hi.
english: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

paite: Belamhonte nusia belamchingmi phattuamna bei tung agik hi; aban tung leh amit taklam tung namsau in adou ding a; aban akeugawp kiuhkeuh ding a, amit taklam amial bikbek ding!" achi hi.
english: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”
